steps.title: Photon sources
steps.text: Add confocal imaging TTTR files and an IRF measurement.

steps.title: Calibration
steps.text: Set detector channels, fit window, G factor and mixing corrections; shared setup/calibration can provide them.

steps.title: Estimator
steps.text: Select fit23, fit24 or fit25 and initial values/fixed flags. Optionally load a saved region.

steps.title: Run and inspect
steps.text: Run in the background, inspect τ and ρ maps, and export the complete per-pixel table.
